# Repository instructions

Treat `docs/PRD.md` as the full product requirement and `README.md` as the accurate implementation status. This repository is an explicitly incomplete starter; do not describe placeholder handlers or templates as operational integrations.

Use TypeScript strict mode, npm lockfile, the official MCP TypeScript SDK, safe YAML parsing, JSON Schema validation, SQLite FTS5, and Vitest. Keep runtime data under ignored `.runtime/`. Validate changes with `npm run build` and focused tests. Never fabricate project facts or evidence. Keep MCP stdio stdout protocol-only. Avoid arbitrary command execution from records or events. Do not modify external application repositories without authorization.
